scope: cofactor arithmetic, strong divisibility, exact borrowing gcd and normalized positive primitive additive triples; no ABC radical bound or FLT descent

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_symm
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_symm
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x y = powerDifferenceCofactor n y x

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_add
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_add
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (a b : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (a + b) x y =
      x ^ a * powerDifferenceCofactor b x y + y ^ b * powerDifferenceCofactor a x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_mul
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_mul
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (a b : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (a * b) x y =
      powerDifferenceCofactor a (x ^ b) (y ^ b) * powerDifferenceCofactor b x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_even
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_even
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (m : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * m) x y =
      (x + y) * powerDifferenceCofactor m (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_square_loan
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_square_loan
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 3) x y +
        x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y =
      (x + y) ^ 2 * powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 1) (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_right
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_right
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y).Coprime y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_left
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_left
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y).Coprime x

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_coordinates
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_coordinates
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y).Coprime (x * y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_self
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_self (m n x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor (n + m) x y) =
      Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_mul_self
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_mul_self (m n k x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor (n + k * m) x y) =
      Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor (m n x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) =
      powerDifferenceCofactor (Nat.gcd m n) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.isStrongDvdSequence_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem isStrongDvdSequence_powerDifferenceCofactor (x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.IsStrongDvdSequence (fun n => powerDifferenceCofactor n x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.powerDifferenceCofactor_dvd_of_dvd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_dvd_of_dvd {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ∣ b) (x y : ℕ) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor a x y ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor b x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan (n x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (n + 2) x y)
        (x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) =
      powerDifferenceCofactor (Nat.gcd n 2) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan_odd (k x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 3) x y)
        (x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y) = 1

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan_even
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_loan_even (k x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 4) x y)
        (x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 2) x y) = x + y

declarations.source_signature: def completionLoanB (n x y : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_numerators_add
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_numerators_add {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x y : ℕ) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x y + x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 2) x y =
      (x + y) * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoanFactor_eq_gcd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoanFactor_eq_gcd {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    completionLoanFactor n x y =
      Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) (x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 2) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoanFactor_pos
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoanFactor_pos (n x y : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < completionLoanFactor n x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoanFactor_dvd_numerators
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoanFactor_dvd_numerators {n x y : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    completionLoanFactor n x y ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor n x y ∧
    completionLoanFactor n x y ∣ x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 2) x y ∧
    completionLoanFactor n x y ∣ (x + y) * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_reconstruct
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_reconstruct {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    completionLoanA n x y * completionLoanFactor n x y = powerDifferenceCofactor n x y ∧
    completionLoanB n x y * completionLoanFactor n x y =
      x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 2) x y ∧
    completionLoanC n x y * completionLoanFactor n x y =
      (x + y) * powerDifferenceCofactor (n - 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_add
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_add {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    completionLoanA n x y + completionLoanB n x y = completionLoanC n x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_pos
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_pos {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    0 < completionLoanA n x y ∧ 0 < completionLoanB n x y ∧ 0 < completionLoanC n x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_pairwise_coprime
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_pairwise_coprime {n x y : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (completionLoanA n x y).Coprime (completionLoanB n x y) ∧
    (completionLoanB n x y).Coprime (completionLoanC n x y) ∧
    (completionLoanA n x y).Coprime (completionLoanC n x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionLoan_primitive_triple
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionLoan_primitive_triple {n x y : ℕ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    0 < completionLoanA n x y ∧ 0 < completionLoanB n x y ∧ 0 < completionLoanC n x y ∧
    completionLoanA n x y + completionLoanB n x y = completionLoanC n x y ∧
    (completionLoanA n x y).Coprime (completionLoanB n x y) ∧
    (completionLoanB n x y).Coprime (completionLoanC n x y) ∧
    (completionLoanA n x y).Coprime (completionLoanC n x y)
